exposure: planned home birth within a Midwifery Group Practice (MGP) model
planned hospital birth within the same MGP model
cohort: The study included women who received care through a Midwifery Group Practice, matched by parity, age, BMI, spontaneous labour, and gestation of 37-42 weeks.
finding: Women who planned to birth at home were more likely to have a physiological birth and intact perineum, and less likely to have a postpartum haemorrhage compared to the matched cohort who birthed in hospital.
mod_finding: Women who transferred from home to hospital had fewer assisted births and caesarean section births compared to the hospital birth group.
